item.title: Pope, an avid athlete, extols physical and spiritual benefits of sport in Olympic message
item.description: ROME (AP) — He called for sport to be accessible, to both poor people and women especially, and for fans to refrain from turning sport into a fanatical religion. Athletes, too, he said, must refrain from narcissism and becoming obsessed with their image and success. The post Pope, an avid athlete, extols physical and spiritual benefits of sport in Olympic message appeared first on RNS.

item.title: Suicide bombing at a Shiite mosque on Islamabad’s outskirts kills at least 31 and wounds scores
item.description: ISLAMABAD (AP) — Television footage and social media images showed police and residents transporting the wounded to nearby hospitals. Some of the wounded in the attack on the sprawling mosque of Khadija Al-Kubra were reported to be in critical condition. item.title: Special prosecutor to get cases of man who says North Carolina religious group beat him in 2013
item.description: (AP) — Word of Faith had about 700 members in North Carolina a decade ago, but a sworn statement from a former church leader said membership now had dwindled to about 300 to 400 people. item.title: Tourists stopped from seeing The Last Supper, while Olympic VIPs including Vance visit
item.description: MILAN (AP) — The painting, created between 1494 and 1498 by the Italian Renaissance artist, is located on a wall inside the refectory of Santa Maria delle Grazie, a church and Dominican convent still used by friars. It is a major attraction for appreciators of art and devout Catholics alike. The post Tourists stopped from seeing The Last Supper, while Olympic VIPs including Vance visit appeared first on RNS.

item.title: Vatican again OKs Archbishop Fulton Sheen beatification after 2019 ceremony derailed at last minute
item.description: ROME (AP) — After a rare six-year delay to investigate the concerns, Sheen's beatification can now take place in Peoria, Ill., as originally planned, the Peoria diocese announced Monday. item.description: (RNS) — The convening will train rabbis on practical tools for non-violent resistance — both to disrupt systems with tactics such as boycotts and strikes, and to create alternative processes to help vulnerable populations under threat. item.title: We must give Jewish youth an identity beyond the trauma of antisemitism
